bounded_objective: Remove the full-star/all-coordinates-active hypothesis by proving a dimension-free GU' inequality for one quadratic star supported on an arbitrary subset of the point-defect variables, including all restrictions and boundary functions.
prior_status: AUTHOR_PROVED_PENDING_REVIEW: the full-star class R=[n] satisfied G<=8I, but its proof paid one bounded parent U per coordinate and did not cover inactive coordinates of influence 2^{1-n}.
mathematical_delta: Proved G<=14I, U<=14I, and H<=30I on the restriction-closed partial-star/point-defect class. The new fiber pairing uniformly pays an unbounded number of inactive rare coordinates and all parity-shifted defect boundaries.

class_parameters.overlap: one quadratic centre and one point defect share the t active variables; defect also has n-t inactive variables

remaining_obstacle: The proof has one quadratic centre. With two overlapping centres, a dust fiber can receive incompatible upper-set caps, and no single-use physical pivotal payment is proved.
next_action: Analyze two quadratic star centres sharing one point defect, parameterized by support sizes and overlap; derive the four-way fiber charge and prove a single-use payment or produce a genuine growing G/I falsifier.
